run_pybullet_signed_distance_field_simul: run the pybullet signed distance field simulation with a concave box, spheres, and duck URDF models
load_urdf_concave_box: load a concave box URDF model into the pybullet physics simulation environment
load_multiple_sphere_urdfs: load multiple sphere URDF models positioned in a row within the pybullet simulation
configure_pybullet_simulation_timestep: configure the pybullet simulation time step to 1/240 seconds for physics stepping
step_pybullet_simulation_loop: step the pybullet simulation forward in a continuous loop with gravity and loaded URDF models
